mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% relative to its 5-year median indicates accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate (UNRATE) falling below 3.5% signals labor market tightness that fuels wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0% indicates persistent inflation without monetary easing, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to yield pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 320 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0% over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rising above 4.0% for 3 consecutive months signals active monetary tightening, reducing liquidity and increasing risk aversion to produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 50% of instances during FEDFUNDS 3-month rise periods over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 1350 indicate strong consumer confidence and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through sustained demand.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 55% of instances when HOUST > 1350 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 105.0 signals robust manufacturing output and economic growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of instances when INDPRO > 105.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: PAYEMS > 159000 combined with RSAFS > 720000 indicates strong labor market and consumer spending, creating a virtuous cycle that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 55% of instances when PAYEMS > 159000 and RSAFS > 720000 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDPC1 growth rate exceeding 3.0% annualized in late-cycle expansion indicates economic overvaluation and imminent rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized over any 4-year rolling window.
